newsitem.title: USA: Ringer Corp looks for sales gains in FY97.
newsitem.headline: Ringer Corp looks for sales gains in FY97.

text.p: Ringer Corp president Stanley Goldberg said the company is targeting improved sales in fiscal 1997 as a result of new product introductions such as Weed-Away Lawn Weed Killer and from increased distribution from new accounts.

"In addition to higher sales in 1997, we believe our operating performance should improve since our margins are strong, our expense management initiatives are firmly in place and our breakeven point is at its lowest level in years," Goldberg said in a statement.
Earlier, the marketer of lawn and garden products reported a loss of $0.10 per share for the fourth quarter ended September 30 on sales of $1.4 million.

Goldberg said even though the company did not complete a proposed acquisition of The Chas. H.Lilly Co, a marketer of fertilizers, pesticides and seed products, "merger and acquisition activities will continue to play a major role in the further development of Ringer."
